title: Commercial refrigeration controller vulnerabilities and UK coordinated remediation
summary: UK authorities and researchers disclosed vulnerabilities in RDM commercial refrigeration controllers. RDM says initial patches and customer guidance have been issued; thousands of internet-exposed controllers may remain vulnerable, according to researchers. Actual UK compromise has not been established.

rootCause.summary: Researchers identified remotely reachable security weaknesses in commercial refrigeration management equipment. Exact technical exploit details and comprehensive remediation verification are not public.

history.summary: The UK NCSC and researchers disclosed a confidential coordinated response to weaknesses in RDM commercial refrigeration management equipment. RDM reported initial software patches and customer mitigation advice. Some equipment may remain internet-exposed; the UK was not confirmed to have suffered the European attacks.
